title: AI Companies and Tech Leaders Promise Support for the Public Good
subtitle: As artificial intelligence grows, major firms and leaders are pledging shares to help society manage the changes ahead.

summary.en: Anthropic has announced it will place 5% of its company shares into a fund for the public good. This move comes as the AI developer prepares for a major stock market listing. Elon Musk has also pledged to give SpaceX shares to children across America. These announcements arrive amid widespread concern regarding the impact of AI on jobs and safety. Industry leaders are now facing pressure to address the risks associated with rapid technological progress.
summary.zh: Anthropic 宣布將把公司 5% 的股份投入一個公共利益基金。此舉正值該人工智慧開發商準備進行重大股票上市之際。馬斯克也承諾將贈送 SpaceX 股份給全美兒童。這些公告是在大眾對人工智慧在就業與安全方面的影響普遍感到擔憂的背景下發布的。產業領袖目前正面臨壓力，必須解決快速技術進步所帶來的風險。

paragraphs.en: As artificial intelligence (AI) continues to change the world, the companies behind these powerful tools are facing growing pressure to prove they care about more than just profits. Recently, Anthropic, the developer of the Claude chatbot, announced a major plan to support the public good. The company has committed 5% of its shares to a special fund. According to The Guardian, this fund could be worth nearly $48 billion based on the company’s recent valuation. Anthropic plans to use this money to support non-profit organizations or provide direct financial help to specific groups of people.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著人工智慧（AI）持續改變世界，這些強大工具背後的公司正面臨越來越大的壓力，必須證明他們不僅僅是為了獲利。近期，聊天機器人 Claude 的開發商 Anthropic 宣布了一項支持公共利益的重大計畫。該公司已承諾將其 5% 的股份撥入一個特別基金。根據《衛報》（The Guardian）報導，基於該公司近期的估值，這筆基金的價值可能接近 480 億美元。Anthropic 計畫利用這筆資金來支持非營利組織，或為特定群體提供直接的經濟援助。

paragraphs.en: This decision is part of a larger effort by Anthropic to prepare for its entry into the stock market, an event known as an initial public offering, or IPO. An IPO is when a private company first sells its shares to the public. The company hopes this move will show investors and the public that it is committed to responsible growth. Anthropic was founded in 2021 as a “public benefit corporation,” which means its leaders are legally required to balance making money with doing good for society. The company stated that the fund will not be used for political donations or lobbying.
paragraphs.zh: 這項決定是 Anthropic 為進入股票市場做準備的一環，也就是所謂的首次公開募股（IPO）。首次公開募股是指一家私人公司首次向大眾出售其股份。該公司希望此舉能向投資者和大眾展現其致力於負責任成長的決心。Anthropic 成立於 2021 年，是一家「公益公司」，這意味著其領導層在法律上有義務在獲利與造福社會之間取得平衡。該公司表示，這筆基金不會用於政治捐款或遊說活動。

paragraphs.en: Public nervousness about AI is rising. Many people worry that these new technologies will take away jobs, harm the environment, or change how we interact with one another. Research from the International Monetary Fund (IMF) suggests that AI could affect up to 60% of jobs in advanced economies. In a blog post, Anthropic acknowledged these fears, noting that while AI can create great economic value, it could also cause instability for workers. The company has already spent $200 million on safety and social issues, but it believes a “bolder approach” is now necessary.
paragraphs.zh: 大眾對人工智慧的擔憂日益增加。許多人擔心這些新技術會取代工作機會、破壞環境，或改變人與人之間的互動方式。國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）的研究顯示，人工智慧可能影響先進經濟體中高達 60% 的工作職位。Anthropic 在一篇部落格文章中承認了這些恐懼，並指出雖然人工智慧能創造巨大的經濟價值，但也可能導致勞工的不穩定。該公司此前已投入 2 億美元於安全與社會議題，但他們認為現在需要採取「更大膽的做法」。

paragraphs.en: Anthropic is not the only company thinking about its role in society. Elon Musk, the head of Tesla and SpaceX, recently made his own pledge. After seeing Anthropic’s announcement, Musk shared on social media that he would give one of his SpaceX shares to every child in America next year. While the details of how this will work are not yet clear, the move highlights a growing trend of tech leaders attempting to share their wealth as their companies grow in power. BBC Business reported that Musk’s announcement came shortly after he suggested that giving shares directly to the public is a better way to help people than creating a managed fund.
paragraphs.zh: Anthropic 並非唯一一家思考自身社會角色的公司。特斯拉（Tesla）與太空探索技術公司（SpaceX）的負責人伊隆·馬斯克（Elon Musk）近期也做出了自己的承諾。在看到 Anthropic 的公告後，馬斯克在社群媒體上表示，他明年將贈送他持有的其中一股 SpaceX 股份給每一位美國兒童。雖然這項計畫的具體運作細節尚不明確，但此舉凸顯了一種日益增長的趨勢，即科技領袖在公司勢力壯大之際，試圖分享他們的財富。BBC 商業新聞報導指出，馬斯克的這項宣布是在他暗示直接向大眾發放股份比設立管理基金更能幫助民眾之後不久提出的。

paragraphs.en: Safety remains a central concern for the entire industry. Some experts are worried that AI models are becoming too powerful, too quickly. Last week, Anthropic reported that some of its models could soon become “self-replicating,” meaning they might learn to copy themselves and control internet-connected devices like smart appliances without human help. This news has added to the anxiety felt by many in the field. Jacob Coxon, a former researcher at Anthropic, told the BBC that some people working on this technology are “genuinely frightened” by how fast things are moving.
paragraphs.zh: 安全仍然是整個產業的核心關切。一些專家擔心人工智慧模型變得太過強大且速度過快。上週，Anthropic 報告稱其部分模型可能很快就會具備「自我複製」能力，這意味著它們可能會在沒有人類協助的情況下，學會複製自身並控制連網裝置，例如智慧家電。這則新聞加劇了許多業內人士的焦慮。曾任職於 Anthropic 的研究員雅各·考克森（Jacob Coxon）告訴 BBC，一些從事這項技術開發的人員對於技術進展的速度感到「真心恐懼」。

paragraphs.en: In response to these dangers, some industry leaders have called for a slowdown in development. Anthropic’s head, Dario Amodei, has suggested that the industry needs to move more slowly to ensure safety. This idea has been supported by other leaders, including Sam Altman of OpenAI and Elon Musk. They argue for better regulation and independent monitoring of AI development. However, there is no total agreement on how to achieve this. While some leaders want stricter rules, others, including US President Donald Trump, have expressed hesitation about passing new laws that might limit the development of the technology.
paragraphs.zh: 為了應對這些危險，一些產業領袖呼籲放緩開發腳步。Anthropic 的負責人達里歐·阿莫代（Dario Amodei）建議，產業需要放慢速度以確保安全。這個想法得到了包括 OpenAI 的山姆·奧特曼（Sam Altman）和馬斯克在內的其他領袖的支持。他們主張加強監管並對人工智慧的開發進行獨立監控。然而，對於如何達成這一目標，目前尚未達成完全共識。雖然一些領袖希望制定更嚴格的規則，但包括美國總統川普（Donald Trump）在內的其他人，對於通過可能限制技術發展的新法律表達了猶豫。

paragraphs.en: As Anthropic prepares for its stock market debut in November, it is trying to balance its high costs with its public mission. The company reported that its revenue grew by 45% in the three months ending in September, reaching $16.8 billion. Despite this success, the company faces a difficult path. It must prove that it can be profitable while also spending the billions of dollars needed to build the infrastructure that powers its AI models.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著 Anthropic 為 11 月的股票市場首秀做準備，該公司正試圖在高昂成本與公共使命之間取得平衡。該公司報告稱，截至 9 月的三個月內，營收成長了 45%，達到 168 億美元。儘管取得了成功，該公司仍面臨艱難的道路。它必須證明自己能在獲利的同時，還能投入數十億美元來建設支撐其人工智慧模型所需的基礎設施。

paragraphs.en: Ultimately, the actions taken by Anthropic and other tech giants reflect a changing landscape. As AI becomes a bigger part of daily life, the public is demanding more accountability. Whether these share pledges and promises of safety will be enough to calm fears remains to be seen. For now, the industry is under a microscope, with the world watching to see if these companies can truly balance their massive financial ambitions with the needs of the people they serve.
paragraphs.zh: 歸根結底，Anthropic 與其他科技巨頭所採取的行動反映了不斷變化的環境。隨著人工智慧成為日常生活的重要部分，大眾正要求更高的問責制。這些股份承諾與安全保證是否足以平息恐懼，仍有待觀察。目前，整個產業正處於顯微鏡下，全世界都在關注這些公司是否真的能將其龐大的財務雄心與所服務民眾的需求取得平衡。

keyTerms.definitionEn: Units of ownership in a company that are bought and sold on the stock market.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作動詞（分享），這裡作名詞，指公司股份。文中：The company has committed 5% of its shares to a special fund.

keyTerms.definitionEn: An action taken to achieve a specific goal or progress.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作動詞（移動），這裡作名詞，指為了達成目標所採取的行動。文中：The company hopes this move will show investors and the public that it is committed to responsible growth.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Being watched or examined very closely.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 受到密切檢視；被放大檢視。
keyTerms.noteZh: 字面意思是「在顯微鏡下」，這裡指受到公眾或媒體嚴格的監督。文中：For now, the industry is under a microscope, with the world watching to see if these companies can truly balance their massive financial ambitions with the needs of the people they serve.

quiz.question: What specific limitation has Anthropic placed on the use of its newly announced fund?

options.A: It cannot be used to support non-profit organizations.
options.B: It cannot be utilized for political donations or lobbying efforts.
options.C: It cannot be used to cover the costs of building AI infrastructure.
options.D: It cannot be used to provide direct financial assistance to individuals.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第二段，Anthropic 明確指出該基金將不會用於政治捐款或遊說活動。選項 A 與文章第一段提到將支持非營利組織的內容衝突。選項 C 雖提到公司面臨高昂的基礎設施成本，但文中並未將基金限制於此。選項 D 錯誤，因為文章第一段明確提到該基金可用於提供特定群體的直接經濟援助。

quiz.question: Based on the text, why might Anthropic’s decision to commit 5% of its shares be strategically important for its upcoming IPO?

options.A: It ensures that the company will have enough cash to pay its employees.
options.B: It allows the company to avoid all government regulations regarding AI.
options.C: It helps build public and investor trust by demonstrating a commitment to corporate social responsibility.
options.D: It guarantees that the company's stock price will increase immediately after the IPO.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章第二段提到，此舉是為了向投資者和公眾展示公司致力於「負責任的成長」，且該公司作為「公共利益公司」有法律義務平衡獲利與社會責任。這顯示該決策是為了提升品牌形象與信任度。選項 A 錯誤，文中未提及此舉與員工薪資的關聯。選項 B 錯誤，文中提到業界反而更呼籲加強監管。選項 D 錯誤，文章並未保證股價會上漲，僅提到這是一種策略性的公關與經營方針。

quiz.question: In the final paragraph, what does the phrase 'under a microscope' imply about the current state of the AI industry?

options.A: The industry is being closely watched and scrutinized by the public.
options.B: The industry is focused on developing tiny, microscopic technologies.
options.C: The industry is currently suffering from a lack of scientific research.
options.D: The industry is being hidden from view to protect trade secrets.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。片語「under a microscope」在文中意指某個事物正受到嚴格的審視與關注。根據上下文，由於 AI 對社會影響巨大且引發擔憂，大眾與監管機構正在密切檢視這些公司的行為。選項 B 是對字面意思的錯誤理解。選項 C 與文章內容無關，因為文中提到 AI 發展極快。選項 D 與文意相反，因為「under a microscope」意味著透明度與被監督，而非隱藏。

quiz.question: What is the primary message of the article regarding the current state of AI companies?

options.A: AI companies are primarily focused on maximizing profits, ignoring all social concerns.
options.B: Tech leaders have reached a total agreement on how to regulate AI development safely.
options.C: AI companies are attempting to balance their financial ambitions with growing public demands for accountability and safety.
options.D: The development of AI has already been successfully slowed down by government regulation.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章的核心主旨探討了 AI 公司（特別是 Anthropic）如何在追求商業獲利與回應大眾對安全、社會責任之擔憂之間取得平衡。選項 A 過於偏頗，忽略了文中提到公司所做的努力。選項 B 錯誤，文章第六段明確指出「沒有達成完全共識」。選項 D 錯誤，文中提到雖然有呼籲放慢腳步的聲音，但目前尚未有統一的法律限制，且發展速度仍是各界擔憂的焦點。
